about: Event entity written by ecl::party::PartySystem::Update (bg3.exe+0x1949EF0) and read by gui::AssignedCharactersSystem (macOS). The system collects a HashMap<EntityHandle, pair of EntityHandles> of members whose two party handles differ (old != new) and creates one event entity per entry. Born live in party/summon steps (with GroupsChangedEvent, summons).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x194B100 (0x18 bytes) initialises three null handles; bg3.exe+0x1949EF0 writes the 8-byte map key here. Live: entity handles.
Second handle of the map value (value[1]); the map only keeps entries whose two handles differ. Live: handle or 0/null. Probably the new or old party (view) entity - not established.
First handle of the map value (value[0]). Live: handle or 0/null.

open_questions: Which of +8/+0x10 is the old and which the new party/group entity.
